bio: Pelletreau ([R4-S1]): 'Anna, widow of Ebenezer Smith, married Zephaniah Platt, and died March 12, 1813.' (The same date is given for her daughter Temperance Platt; one of the two may be an error.) Her children by Ebenezer include Richard 4th, grandfather of Judge J. Lawrence Smith; so she is the link that makes the J. Lawrence Smith family, James Clinch Smith and Bessie Smith White John's cousins through Job Smith 1st.

conflicts.found: 12 Mar 1813 for Anna and also for her daughter Temperance (Pelletreau)
conflicts.assessment: Identical dates for mother and daughter suggest a copying error in Pelletreau; verify with gravestones.
